description: This file defines the class 'ScenarioSetup', which encapsulates configuration and expectations for a specific test scenario related to authorization policies in the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes multiple constructors for flexible initialization, getter methods, and a custom toString implementation.

classes.name: ScenarioSetup
classes.description: A class representing the setup of a test scenario for authorization policy enforcement, including policies, resources, permissions, expected outcomes, and optional additional algorithms.

methods.name: ScenarioSetup
methods.description: Multiple overloaded constructors for initializing a ScenarioSetup instance with various levels of detail.

methods.name: getPolicy
methods.description: Returns the policy associated with the scenario.

methods.name: getAuthorizationContext
methods.description: Returns the authorization context of the scenario.

methods.name: getResource
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer resource involved in the scenario.

methods.name: getRequiredPermissions
methods.description: Returns the set of permissions required by the scenario.

methods.name: getExpectedResult
methods.description: Returns the expected boolean result (allow/deny) of the scenario.

methods.name: getFullJsonifiable
methods.description: Returns an Optional wrapping the full JSON representation if available.

methods.name: getExpectedSubjectIds
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the set of expected subject IDs.

methods.name: getExpectedJsonView
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the expected JSON view.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the scenario.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the scenario.

methods.name: getAdditionalAlgorithmFunction
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing a function for additional policy algorithm processing if provided.
